nodes.text: Synthetic State Q DOI Claims Bulletin Q-2026-07, effective 2026-04-01, requires a claimant contact or documented attempt within 3 business days of notice and retention of the attempt timestamp.

Claims Workflow v2.1, released 2026-03-20 and deployed to State Q production on 2026-03-28, creates a 3-business-day task, stores claimant_contact_attempt_at and contact_outcome, and carries rule ID Q-2026-07.
Release test Q-2026-07-CT confirms a notice on a Friday creates the correct next-business-day sequence, a 3-business-day deadline, and an immutable contact-attempt record.
Production manifest for State Q at 2026-06-01 lists CW-2.1 and the Q-2026-07 migration as active; CW-1.4 is archived.
Synthetic State S bulletin S-2026-02, version 1.1 effective 2026-01-01, confirms that the existing 30-day claim acknowledgment standard remains unchanged; it adds no new production obligation.
Production Acknowledgment Workflow v4 retains a 30-day acknowledgment task and maps it to rule S-2026-02-v1.1. The prior v3 workflow is retired.
The annual State S review found the deployed 30-day task matches the current bulletin and recorded no changed obligation requiring propagation.
